This weekly discussion is about what you can do with eggs!

A chance to share recipes, meal ideas and other related discussion to the ingredient.
Weekly ingredient thread: What can you do with eggs?

Eating healthy? Hard boil a dozen and a half on Sunday and put them back in the container. Then you've got a healthy, quick breakfast for the rest of the week.

I usually have 2 eggs, a banana, and a protein shake most days for breakfast! Hits all the bases and keeps me from going for the sugary stuff.

2 eggs, microwave safe dish, yep, I'm going there

 

Beat 'em

Nuke 'em for a minute

add ya toppings [kale, olives, sun dried tomatoes, whatever]

Stir it up

Nuke for another minute

Let it stand for one more minute and it will finish cooking.

I love making loaded veggie omelettes with them. Some mushrooms, cherry tomatoes, red onions, spinach, some grated cheddar and then just serving it folded. I think that tastes amazing as a breakfast food, filling and filled with a bunch of goodness.

As for a lunch/dinner food, I love making them into fritattas. For those that haven't tried one yet, it's a baked egg dish very similar to omelettes and is similar to a quiche without a crust. You can fill them up with similar things and serve a slice along with a salad and it's usually a crowd pleaser.

Last favourite thing to do with eggs for me: salads. I think they really fill one up. I'm not talking about egg and mayo salads or anything you get with heavy sauce or dressing, but something with baby Italian leaves, plum tomatoes, red onions, some black olives, a splash of red wine vinegar, squeeze of lemon juice and a light serving of dijon mustard and you're golden. I change this recipe up sometimes and add avocado instead of egg, but it's nice with eggs too.

Hard boiled, poached, or scrambled. All of those can be made without added salt, oil, seasoning, etc. (not that any of those are inherently bad. eggs just don't need anything extra in my opinion).

Meringue cookies are also surprisingly healthy for being delicious cookies, as long as you don't go overboard on the sugar: beat some egg whites with a touch of sugar, maybe cocoa powder and cinnamon if you like, maybe a bit of stabilizer too. Dollop on a silpat and bake! Low-cal, mostly protein, and super easy.
